Maximize Your Success at Cochise County Tax Lien Auctions for Big Wins!

Known for its rich history and promising future in real estate investment, Cochise County, Alabama offers tax lien certificates to recoup unpaid property taxes, helping finance essential public services and opening up lucrative investment opportunities. By purchasing a tax lien certificate, you’re essentially lending money to the property owner to cover overdue taxes. This process can yield returns of up to 16% per annum, making it an attractive investment strategy.

Why Invest in a Tax Lien Certificate in Cochise County?

  • Historical and Agricultural Significance: Once known as the nation’s Cattle Capital, Cochise County hosts Arizona’s largest weekly cattle auction and is a hub for sustainable, off-grid living.
  • High Returns: The interest rate starts at 16% and can be bid down during auctions.
  • Sustainable Living: Laws encourage sustainable living practices such as rainwater harvesting and solar power, attracting those seeking a simpler life.

How to Participate?

  • Visit the County Treasurer’s Website: Download a list of tax liens available for purchase and register for the auction online.
  • Familiarize Yourself with the Process: Understand the tax lien sale information and list of properties available for lien sale.
  • Register: Provide your personal details and identification numbers for registration.
  • Bid Down Procedure: Auctions follow a ‘Bid Down’ procedure where the interest rate starts at 16% and is bid down during the auction.
  • Maintain Your Lien: Stay informed about subsequent taxes to maintain your lien position.

Key Points to Remember

  • Multiple Lean Holders: Be aware that if you don’t cover subsequent unpaid taxes, other investors can step in, potentially affecting your position.
  • Sale is for Tax Liens, Not Property: The amount you pay includes taxes, interest, penalties, and fees.
  • Follow-Up: Pay subsequent taxes after June 1 each year to maintain your lien.

Interesting Facts about Real Estate in Cochise County

  • Ancient Civilization: Human civilization along the San Pedro River dates back to 9000-6000 B.C.
  • Agricultural Hub: Covers 6,219 square miles and is known for its cattle auction.
  • Homesteading Trend: More Americans are moving to the County for off-grid living due to favourable building laws.

FAQs

Q: What is a tax lien certificate?

A: When a property owner fails to pay their property taxes, the government issues a certificate, which investors can then purchase.

Q: How much can I earn from tax lien certificates in Cochise County?

A: You can earn up to 16% return per annum.

Q: When are the tax lien auctions held in Cochise County?

A: They take place in February.

Q: What do I need to register for the auction?

A: You need to provide your personal details, identification numbers, and register on the GovEase auction site.

Q: What happens if I don’t pay subsequent taxes?

A: Other investors can purchase liens on the subsequent unpaid taxes, affecting your lien position.

Cochise County Tax Lien Auction Details

Tax Sale Type: Tax Lien Certificates

Typical Date of Sale: February

Redemption Period: 3 Years

Interest Rate: 16% Per Annum

Bid Procedure: Bid Down

Auction Site: http://www.govease.com

County Website: Cochise County, AZ

Contact Information

For further details or questions, you can contact the Cochise County Back Tax Department at 520-432-8400 (option 3, then option 2) or email them directly.
